title: RegistrationStatus
description: Status of the Person in the register.

fileStatus.description: Status of the Registration file. In the National Register, used when the registration in the register is no longer valid, for example: because the person has been removed from the register, a previous registration was canceled, or the person has died, etc. Lijst van FileStatus items.

canceledFile.description: The previous registration of a Person in the register. Only applicable if a new Registration exists. Lijst van Identifier items.
